shots.action: High over the cloud: the bomber rolls over and goes down, an engine burning, smoke trailing; a tiny figure falls away from it
shots.camera: Wide from below and ahead, pushing in hard, slight roll

shots.action: From above: one limp figure turning slowly in open sky, no parachute, cloud far below and the coast beyond
shots.camera: Straight down on him, sinking towards him, rolling

shots.action: Straight down at the arched glass roof of the station among the town roofs, rushing up
shots.camera: Vertical dive, spinning

shots.action: Rook on the iron ridge of the station roof looks up at a tiny falling figure, then at us; his brim drops: no chance
shots.camera: Three-quarter on Rook from roof level, easing in

shots.action: An airfield in England at dawn: the bomber parked on its hardstand; the gunner walks out to it. Rook on a fuel drum flips a coin and turns to watch
shots.camera: Low and wide, easing in

shots.action: Under the belly of the bomber: the ball turret just above the grass. The gunner kneels and slaps its side; Rook bends to look at how small it is
shots.camera: Low from the side, level with the ball, tracking a little

shots.action: Inside the ball, from beside him: curled between the two guns, knees up, the round window and flak-spotted sky in front of him
shots.camera: Inside the turret, very close, easing in

shots.action: Rook holds his wings apart across the ball, keeps them that far apart, turns to a parachute pack on the grass: the two will not go in together. He shrugs
shots.camera: Three-quarter on Rook, the ball behind him

shots.action: Inside the fuselage: his parachute pack, whole, hangs on its hook. He pats it and turns away towards the hatch
shots.camera: From across the fuselage, easing in

shots.action: Rook's chalk map on iron: England, the Channel, Brittany; a dotted line runs out over the sea and down to a ringed harbour
shots.camera: Flat, slow push

shots.action: The formation in daylight over cloud, the sky around it clean for now
shots.camera: Wide from the side, drifting

shots.action: Close on the bomber's nose and cockpit from ahead, the others strung out behind; no name or picture is painted on it
shots.camera: From ahead and to one side, sliding in towards the nose

shots.action: From above the bombers: the harbour of Saint-Nazaire, the long concrete block of the U-boat pens on the basin, the town round it, flak coming up
shots.camera: High, looking down and ahead over the formation

shots.action: Under the belly: a burst right beside the ball turret; the plane jolts and fragments fly
shots.camera: Close under the fuselage

shots.action: Through the round window: the gunner flinches as the glass cracks across; he is hit
shots.camera: Close on his face through the window

shots.action: Inside the fuselage: he hauls himself up out of the turret hatch in the floor, smoke drifting past
shots.camera: From along the floor, rising with him

shots.action: He pulls the pack off its hook; it falls open and the silk drops out in rags. Behind him Rook's hat jumps
shots.camera: Two-shot from down the fuselage

shots.action: The pack, torn open, silk hanging out of it in strips, daylight through the holes in the skin
shots.camera: Close on the pack, easing in

shots.action: Rook holds a strip of the silk to the light, pokes a wingtip through a hole in it, taps his beak: useless
shots.camera: Close three-quarter on Rook

shots.action: The second hit: a burst on the right wing; the outer part breaks away and tumbles back, fire along the stub, the bomber drops that side
shots.camera: From above and behind the right wing

shots.action: The bomber going down in a flat spin, fire on the stub of the wing, its smoke winding up behind it
shots.camera: Wide from the side, falling with it

shots.action: Inside the spinning fuselage: the floor tilts, fire at the far end; he drags himself forward on hands and knees
shots.camera: Low along the floor, the horizon rolling

shots.action: He sways, mask hanging loose, gropes for a rib; his eyes drift shut and he slumps
shots.camera: Close, rolling

shots.action: The broken waist of the bomber: a limp figure is flung out among scraps of metal as the plane rolls away
shots.camera: From beside the waist

shots.action: Close from above as he falls on his back, out cold: eyes shut, arms drifting up, cloud far below
shots.camera: Above his face, sinking with him, turning slowly

shots.action: The small figure alone in the sky, turning
shots.camera: High and wide, from the other side

shots.action: Rook's chalk scale on iron: a tall rule, two marks on it, one for the bomb group's report and one for the later tellings, and under them one line
shots.camera: Flat, slow push

shots.action: Rook dives beside him, one wingtip clamping his hat on, looking across at the man and then down
shots.camera: Close on Rook, the man beyond

shots.action: Straight down past his boots: the town, the harbour, and the long glass roof of the station growing
shots.camera: Vertical, turning

shots.action: Outside the station, from the tracks: the open end of the long hall, its arched roof of glass and iron, steam inside; high above it a very small figure
shots.camera: Low on the tracks, easing in and up

shots.action: On the roof: Rook looks up, his hat jumps off his head, and he backs off down the glass, wings up
shots.camera: Three-quarter on Rook from roof level

shots.action: From the platform, straight up at the roof: a section of glass bursts inward as he comes through
shots.camera: Looking straight up, tilted

shots.action: Glass pours down through the light; Rook at the platform edge has both wings over his head, peeking out
shots.camera: Low along the platform

shots.action: Quiet: straight up at the ragged hole in the roof, iron ribs round it, daylight pouring through, a last few glints falling
shots.camera: Looking straight up, turning slowly

shots.action: Rook picks a shard off the floor, turns it in the light, and looks up at the hole
shots.camera: Low three-quarter on Rook

shots.action: Up at the hole from the platform: Rook crouches on the roof at its edge, points down at the floor, then along at the steel ribs, then turns up one wing: which?
shots.camera: From the platform, looking up at him against the sky

shots.action: Men in plain greatcoats run in and kneel beside him among the glass; his hand moves. Rook stands back, hat to his chest
shots.camera: Low along the track bed, easing in

shots.action: Two of the men carry him on a stretcher along the platform, past the locomotive, dust still in the light
shots.camera: From the next platform, tracking

shots.action: Night in a hospital room, from above the foot of the bed: he lies still under the lamp, one leg in plaster slung from a frame, his arm bound across his chest
shots.camera: High over the foot of the bed, sinking

shots.action: Close on him asleep, the bound right arm across the blanket, his face turned to the lamp
shots.camera: Close from the bedside, easing in

shots.action: The same room by day: a doctor in a white coat bends over him, then straightens
shots.camera: From the foot of the bed, easing in

shots.action: The doctor talks: a hand on his own chest, then a finger towards the bound arm. The gunner has turned his head on the pillow to listen
shots.camera: Across the bed, on the doctor, easing in

shots.action: Rook at the foot of the bed lifts his brim, looks at the man and gives one slow nod
shots.camera: Close three-quarter on Rook

shots.action: The doctor bends over the arm and winds a bandage round it, turn after turn. Rook leans in to watch the hands
shots.camera: Over the bed, on the hands

shots.action: Weeks on, daylight: he sits up against the pillow and lifts the mended arm, opening and closing the hand. Rook copies him with one wing and nods
shots.camera: From the foot of the bed, easing in

shots.action: The doctor at the bedside straightens, nods once and steps back: no name was ever given
shots.camera: From the window side, wider

shots.action: Ten chalk marks on iron for the ten men aboard; three are ringed; a line is drawn under the other seven
shots.camera: Flat, slow push

shots.action: Snow and wire: the three survivors stand together inside the fence, the gunner in the middle with his arm in a sling, the long hut behind them
shots.camera: Along the wire from outside, tracking in

shots.action: The gunner at the wire in the falling snow; Rook perched on a fence post beside him leans towards him
shots.camera: Tracking along the fence and in

shots.action: Spring: the snow is gone and the gate in the wire swings open. He walks out through it, the other two behind him. Rook on the gatepost lifts his hat as they pass
shots.camera: From outside the gate, easing in

shots.action: An open case on a table under a lamp: a heart-shaped medal on a purple ribbon, a round bronze one on a blue ribbon. Rook's wing creeps towards the shine, stops, and goes behind his back
shots.camera: Over the table, easing in

shots.action: A grass airfield at home, late sun: a small yellow aeroplane outside its hangar. An older man walks up and lays his hand on the wing strut. Rook sits out on the wing, legs swinging
shots.camera: Low and wide, easing in

shots.action: The yellow aeroplane in the air, banking over a quilt of fields in low sun, the older man at the controls looking out and down
shots.camera: Air to air, from ahead and to one side

shots.action: A quiet town square: a plain stone memorial with a wreath at its foot; Rook beside it takes his hat to his chest
shots.camera: Wide, moving in

shots.action: Past the edge of the stone: the older man and his wife stand in front of it. He looks up at it for a long moment; she takes his arm. Rook stands apart, hat in his hand
shots.camera: From beside the stone, on their faces

shots.action: Close on the wreath at the foot of the stone; Rook, crouched beside it, lays one more flower on it
shots.camera: Low and close

shots.action: The stone alone in the square, from the other side, the light going
shots.camera: Wide, from the far side, drifting

shots.action: Rook's case board: a photograph of the hole in the station roof behind a cracked pane, and the case in three lines
shots.camera: Flat, slow push

shots.action: Dusk on the station roof beside the hole: Rook looks down through it, then at us, pushes his brim up with one wingtip so his eyes show, and nods: he was wrong
shots.camera: Three-quarter on Rook, easing in

shots.action: Under the hole in the station roof: Rook puts his hat back on, holds up the glass shard so it glints, and pockets it: case closed
shots.camera: Low three-quarter, easing in
